Can I choose what food I want?

Absolutely! You can edit everything in your delivery and get exactly what you want.

Can I change my plan later?

Of course. You can make changes to your plan—or update your dietary needs and preferences—at any time.

How does the subscription work?

Each week we’ll recommend groceries and recipes just for you, and you can make any changes you like. Then, we deliver everything right to your door. Skip any week, pause your deliveries, or cancel any time.

How much do plans cost?

You choose exactly how much food you want, and the more you add to your delivery, the more you save. (We bet your grocery store doesn’t offer that!) When packing your weekly box, we use insulation and ice packs to keep refrigerated items cold during shipping. If your order isn’t perfect, we have a self-help form where you can report what’s wrong and take various steps to remedy the situation. If a shipment is late or missing, please contact our Customer Care team to help resolve your issue.

That means less food waste, fewer trips to the grocery store, and a very happy fridge.

If you want a bit more control over your weekly food order, you can search or shop by recipe or grocery item on our site. If you prefer to hand all of the planning, decision-making, and shopping to us, our predictive technology proactively picks out personalized recipes and grocery staples and automatically adds them to your cart through SmartCart™, so all you need to do is review and approve your weekly grocery order. Think of it like meal planning on autopilot, where you stay in control but never have to start from scratch.

Hungryroot also has strict sourcing standards, screening out over 200+ ingredients like artificial sweeteners, dyes, additives, preservatives, and hydrogenated oils so you don’t have to.

Who are the chefs behind the recipes at Hungryroot?

People who’ve spent their careers obsessed with food. Our recipes come from an in-house team of trained chefs — from French pastry programs to restaurant kitchens to test kitchens at national food magazines — who cook, taste, and fuss over every detail. We use smart tools to scale our library, but a chef tastes, refines, and signs off on each dish so it’s delicious and foolproof in a real home kitchen.

What is Factor?
Factor is a ready-to-heat meal service designed to empower your active lifestyle. We take care of the planning, prepping, and cooking, so you can focus on your goals—not on what’s for dinner. Our chefs and dietitians work hand in hand to create fresh, flavourful meals that are as nutritious as they are delicious. Delivered right to your door, each meal is ready to heat and enjoy in minutes.

\nFlexibility is at the heart of Factor.
\nYou’re in control: choose the weeks you want a delivery, pick your favourites from our rotating menu, skip a week, or pause your subscription anytime.
Why choose Factor?
Factor is the easiest way to eat well without the stress. We do the shopping, chopping, and cooking so you can focus on your goals.

• Delivered fresh, never frozen\*
• Chef-Prepared, Dietitian-Approved: You don't have to choose between flavour and nutrition. Our culinary team and dietitians work together to create meals that are scientifically designed to fuel your body and taste amazing.
• Flexible to your lifestyle: Whether you’re Keto, High Protein, Max 550 kcal or Pescetarian, we have a plan for you. Plus, you can pause, skip, or cancel your subscription at any time - you are always in control.

\*Our meals are delivered fresh to your door. Just heat, eat, and enjoy in minutes - no prep or cleanup required.
Can I cancel anytime?
Yes. You can cancel your subscription at any time through your account settings.
Just keep in mind that once an order has been processed after your weekly cut-off, it can no longer be changed or canceled for that week.

If you wish to cancel your first Factor box, please reach out to our customer care.
How long will my meals stay fresh?
Each meal is labeled with a best-before date so you’ll always know how long it stays fresh. Just keep your meals refrigerated and enjoy them before the date shown on the label.
Are Factor meals gluten-free?
Most of our meals are made without ingredients containing gluten, however, they are not certified gluten-free. All meals are prepared in facilities that also handle gluten-containing ingredients, and cross-contact is possible. As such, our meals are not recommended for individuals with celiac disease or severe gluten sensitivity.

Getting Started
What are the benefits of Factor?

Factor takes the stress out of healthy living. We provide fresh, ready-prepared meals that support even the busiest of lifestyles! We shop, prep, cook, and deliver to your door for you so you can experience the benefits of clean eating without the hassle. When you are fit, you look great, feel amazing and have the energy and focus you need. As an added bonus, our team of dietitians is always available for extra accountability to help you crush your goals with our nutrition coaching programs!

How soon can I get my first order?

We deliver Saturday, Sunday, Monday, Tuesday or Wednesday, depending on your zip code. Our cutoff for any new or modified orders is dependent on your delivery day. For Saturday and Sunday Deliveries, the cutoff is Tuesday at 11:59 pm CT, one week prior to delivery. For all other delivery days, the cutoff will be Wednesday at 11:59 CT for deliveries the following week.

After your first order, you’ll start receiving a box of food every week! You will always have until your cutoff time to modify the order, including the meal selections, plan size, and billing and shipping information.

We need a week of lead time because all meals are completely made fresh-to-order by our chefs. We wait until after the cutoff to order ingredients, so we can assure our ingredients are fresh and we don't have too much.

How do I view the menu without signing up?

You can view our current menu without providing any personal information! On a desktop or laptop, just click, "WEEKLY MENU" at the top of our homepage. On a mobile device, click on the dropdown menu at the top of the page (3 horizontal lines), and click on "WEEKLY MENU."

Are meals fresh or frozen?

Always fresh. We deliver the meals in insulated boxes filled with frozen gel packs designed to keep your food at refrigerated temperatures through transit. Once you receive your meals, you should place them in the fridge ASAP. Once in the fridge, your meals will stay fresh for at least 7 days. Our meals are intended to be enjoyed fresh for optimal quality, we do not recommend freezing.

How do I apply a promo or coupon code during checkout?

When you get started with signup, you can add a promo code or coupon in the section that asks 'Do you have a discount code?'. You can input the code or coupon at checkout.

How many people does one meal feed?

Each meal feeds one adult for one meal. Our meals will vary in nutrition facts and ingredients, so always make sure to check this before ordering each week. You can view a full nutrition label and list of ingredients for each meal by clicking on the image of the meal on our menu page.

Some of our breakfast options work well to be split in two for a lighter breakfast.

Location: Where you live influences your taxes due to state and local tax regulations.

This sophisticated tool ensures that the correct amount is collected and remitted to the appropriate tax authorities on your behalf.

Cancel From Settings (Website experience)

Scroll down until you find Cancel Subscription.
Click Cancel Subscription to open the cancellation flow.

content.text:
# Healthy Meal Delivery Services Comparison & Final Recommendations

To help you establish a sustainable, genuinely healthy meal delivery routine, Hungryroot was evaluated against seven other nationally available, health-focused meal delivery services (8 total contenders):
1. **Hungryroot**
2. **Green Chef**
3. **Factor (Factor75)**
4. **Sunbasket**
5. **Trifecta Nutrition**
6. **Purple Carrot**
7. **Daily Harvest**
8. **CookUnity**

Every entry below draws its operational facts directly from each brand’s live official public plan, pricing, and FAQ pages, sanity-checked against reputable public customer review data (Trustpilot).

---

## 1. Official Service Profiles (from Public Plan & Pricing Pages)

### 1. Hungryroot
* **Format:** Hybrid (grocery store variety + quick-prep recipe meal kits + ready-to-eat prepared meals and snacks; over 50,000 recipes and ~1,000 grocery items).
* **Dietary Styles & Nutrition Angle:** Sourcing standards screen out over 200 artificial additives, artificial sweeteners, dyes, preservatives, and partially hydrogenated oils. Caters to Vegan, Vegetarian, Pescatarian, Keto, Gluten-Free, and Dairy-Free lifestyles. Focus on whole ingredients, wild-caught seafood, and grass-fed meats.
* **Price Range:** Dinners from $8.99/serving, Lunches from $5.99/serving, Breakfasts from $3.99/serving, Snacks/Sweets from $1.99, Drinks from $3.99, Supplements from $0.49.
* **Shipping / Delivery Fees:** Free shipping on orders over $70; standard shipping fee for orders under $70 is not shown on the public FAQ page.
* **Minimum Order Structure:** Order minimum corresponds to plan size (minimum plan deliveries generally require hitting the $65–$70 threshold).
* **Ordering, Skipping & Canceling:** Weekly subscription model. An AI-driven SmartCart suggests meals/groceries based on preferences. Subscribers can fully edit the cart, reschedule, skip any week, or pause/cancel anytime via account settings in the web portal or mobile app prior to the weekly billing cutoff.
* **Customer Sentiment (Trustpilot: 4.2 / 5 across 7,325 reviews):** Customers praise the broad grocery variety, healthy pantry staples, and time saved on meal prep. Critiques typically mention occasional delivery carrier delays or damaged produce during summer transit.

---

### 2. Green Chef
* **Format:** Meal kits (pre-measured ingredients, pre-made signature sauces/marinades, recipe cards; ready in ~30 minutes).
* **Dietary Styles & Nutrition Angle:** Certified organic produce and proteins; certified by the Clean Label Project (tested for heavy metals/toxins). Specific plans include Mediterranean, Plant Based (Vegan/Vegetarian), Gluten Free, High Protein, Calorie Smart (≤650 kcal), Carb Smart, and Functional Nutrition (gut-friendly).
* **Price Range:** $13.99 per serving (standard baseline across 2-, 4-, and 6-person box sizes on the public plan selector).
* **Shipping / Delivery Fees:** Not shown on the public plan configuration page prior to registration/checkout (standard shipping is typically $10.99 at checkout).
* **Minimum Order Structure:** 3 meals for 2 people (6 servings) or 2 meals for 4 people (8 servings) per week.
* **Ordering, Skipping & Canceling:** Weekly subscription. Weekly menu changes allow custom recipe selection after checkout. Customers can skip weeks in advance or cancel anytime online through account settings before the weekly cutoff deadline.
* **Customer Sentiment (Trustpilot: 4.0 / 5 across 4,919 reviews):** Highly rated for ingredient freshness, restaurant-quality organic sauces, and diet-adherent recipes. Criticisms center on the premium price per serving and occasional transit packaging mishaps.

---

### 3. Factor (Factor75)
* **Format:** Prepared meals (fresh, never frozen, ready-to-heat in ~2 minutes).
* **Dietary Styles & Nutrition Angle:** Dietitian-designed and chef-prepared. Focus areas include Keto, High Protein (up to 53g protein per meal), Calorie Smart (≤550 kcal), Flexitarian, Vegetarian, and Pescatarian.
* **Price Range:**
  * 6 meals/week: $13.49 per serving
  * 8 meals/week: $12.99 per serving
  * 10 meals/week: $12.49 per serving
  * 12 meals/week: $11.99 per serving
  * 14 meals/week: $11.49 per serving
  * 18 meals/week: $10.99 per serving
* **Shipping / Delivery Fees:** Not shown on the public FAQ cost section (standard delivery fee is typically $10.99 added during final order billing).
* **Minimum Order Structure:** Minimum plan size is 6 single-serving meals per week.
* **Ordering, Skipping & Canceling:** Continuous auto-renewing subscription. Customers select meals weekly. Changes, pauses, skips, or cancellations must be completed before the weekly cutoff (11:59 PM CT on Tuesday for weekend delivery; Wednesday for weekday delivery).
* **Customer Sentiment (Trustpilot: 3.5 / 5 across 12,496 reviews):** Customers appreciate the zero-prep convenience, high protein density, and robust flavor. Common complaints relate to delivery carrier delays and customer support responsiveness during resolution of missing boxes.

---

### 4. Sunbasket
* **Format:** Hybrid (Meal Kits + Pre-Made "Fresh & Ready" meals + curated Market grocery/breakfast items).
* **Dietary Styles & Nutrition Angle:** Certified organic produce, responsibly sourced meats and wild-caught seafood, clean-ingredient housemade sauces. Dedicated diet plans include Paleo, Carb-Conscious (25–35g net carbs), Gluten-Free Friendly, Diabetes-Friendly (approved by the American Diabetes Association), Vegetarian, Pescatarian, Mediterranean, and Keto-Friendly.
* **Price Range:** Meals start at $9.99 per serving.
* **Shipping / Delivery Fees:** Free shipping on first delivery; ongoing standard shipping fee is not explicitly stated on the public How-It-Works page (typically $9.99 at checkout).
* **Minimum Order Structure:** Minimum of 2 dinners per week (available in 2 or 4 servings each, making 4 total servings the minimum order).
* **Ordering, Skipping & Canceling:** Weekly subscription. Customers can freely mix meal kits and ready-to-eat meals in the same order. Skips, address forwarding, or cancellations are managed online anytime before the weekly cutoff (12:00 PM PST / 3:00 PM EST on your order cutoff day).
* **Customer Sentiment (Trustpilot: 4.3 / 5 across 267 reviews):** Consistently praised for top-tier ingredient quality, high produce freshness, and the flexibility to blend quick kits with zero-prep meals. Downsides mentioned include higher costs on premium seafood/steak upgrades.

---

### 5. Trifecta Nutrition
* **Format:** Prepared meals and bulk meal prep (vacuum-sealed, fully cooked, heat & eat in 2–3 minutes).
* **Dietary Styles & Nutrition Angle:** 100% organic ingredients, macro-balanced for fitness enthusiasts and athletes. Gluten-free facility, humanely raised clean proteins, zero refined sugars or artificial additives. Plans include Clean, Keto, Paleo, Whole30 Friendly, High Protein Vegetarian, and High Protein Vegan.
* **Price Range:**
  * High Protein Vegan / Vegetarian: from $104.93 / week
  * Clean, Keto, Paleo, Whole30 Friendly: from $110.99 / week
  * Meal Prep & Signature A La Carte: from $119.00 / week (individual meals roughly $15–$16 each when purchased in 7-meal baseline packages).
* **Shipping / Delivery Fees:** Not shown on the main plan page (free shipping promos apply to certain packages; standard shipping is revealed in cart).
* **Minimum Order Structure:** 7 meals per week (or $119 minimum for A La Carte meal prep).
* **Ordering, Skipping & Canceling:** Subscription-based. Requires 7 days advance notice prior to delivery to skip an upcoming shipment or cancel the subscription (managed via customer portal or phone at 530-564-8388).
* **Customer Sentiment (Trustpilot: 3.5 / 5 across 132 reviews):** Welcomed by gym-goers and macro-counters for precise portioning, strict organic standards, and clean protein. Some users find the vacuum-sealed texture repetitive and express frustration with the strict 7-day cancellation window.

---

### 6. Purple Carrot
* **Format:** Plant-based Meal Kits, Ready to Eat (RTE) single-serve meals, and vegan grocery items (Pantry).
* **Dietary Styles & Nutrition Angle:** 100% plant-based / vegan. Promotes whole grains, legumes, and fresh vegetables. Dietary filters include High Protein, Gluten-Free, High Fiber, and Less Prep (under 30 minutes).
* **Price Range:**
  * Meal Kits: $13.25 to $14.25 per serving (3 two-serving or 2 four-serving meals).
  * Ready to Eat: $13.00 to $18.00 per single-serve meal.
* **Shipping / Delivery Fees:** Free shipping on orders of $120 or more; $12.00 flat shipping fee on orders under $120 (with a $15.00 location surcharge for select remote zip codes).
* **Minimum Order Structure:** $65.00 order minimum required when modifying an order or building a box.
* **Ordering, Skipping & Canceling:** Auto-renewing weekly subscription. You can customize meals across kits and prepared dishes, skip upcoming weeks, or cancel via account settings before the weekly cutoff.
* **Customer Sentiment (Trustpilot: 2.0 / 5 across 916 reviews):** Users love the creative vegan recipe concepts and diverse flavors. However, customer sentiment is heavily impacted by complaints regarding billing after cancellation, difficulty pausing, and occasional missing recipe ingredients.

---

### 7. Daily Harvest
* **Format:** Frozen prepared plant-based food (Smoothies, Harvest Bowls, Protein Oat Bowls, Soups, Flatbreads, Bites; ready in minutes).
* **Dietary Styles & Nutrition Angle:** 100% plant-based, built on certified organic fruits and vegetables. Flash-frozen at source to preserve nutrients; free of refined sugars, artificial preservatives, and dairy. Dietitian-developed, HSA/FSA eligible via Truemed.
* **Price Range:**
  * Classic Smoothies: $8.49 each; Protein Smoothies: $9.49 each.
  * Curated Bundles: $60.99 (7 items, $8.71/serve) to $120.99 (14 items, $8.64/serve).
* **Shipping / Delivery Fees:** Flat rate of $9.99 per delivery.
* **Minimum Order Structure:** Minimum of 6 frozen items required per checkout.
* **Ordering, Skipping & Canceling:** Available as both a flexible subscription and one-time orders. Subscribers can adjust delivery frequency (weekly or monthly), swap items, skip orders, or cancel anytime up to 3 days prior to the estimated delivery day.
* **Customer Sentiment (Trustpilot: 3.7 / 5 across 53 reviews):** Commended for delicious, high-nutrient smoothies and healthy breakfast/lunch convenience. Some reviewers note smaller portion sizes on savory bowls and express caution following historical ingredient recall events.

---

### 8. CookUnity
* **Format:** Chef-crafted prepared meals (fresh, never frozen, delivered fully cooked in compostable/recyclable packaging; reheat in oven or microwave in 2–3 minutes).
* **Dietary Styles & Nutrition Angle:** Handcrafted by independent restaurant chefs in regional culinary hubs. Extensive dietary filters including Low Calorie (<600 kcal), Low Carb, Keto, Paleo, Vegan, Vegetarian, Dairy-Free, Gluten-Free, and GLP-1 tailored dishes.
* **Price Range:** Visible starting price per serving is not shown on the pre-login public page (pricing is revealed after entering zip code/tier, typically ranging from ~$11.00 to $13.50 per meal depending on quantity, with premium chef surcharges on select items).
* **Shipping / Delivery Fees:** Delivery fees and logistical service fees vary by location and are calculated at checkout; offers a "UnityPass" membership for discounted/free delivery benefits.
* **Minimum Order Structure:** 4 meals per week minimum (tiers available for 4, 6, 8, 12, or 16 meals/week, or one-time orders).
* **Ordering, Skipping & Canceling:** Weekly subscription with an "Autopilot" backup feature that auto-fills favorite chef styles if you miss the cutoff. Modifications, skips, pauses, and cancellations must be made 4 to 6 days prior to delivery day at noon.
* **Customer Sentiment (Trustpilot: 4.1 / 5 across 834 reviews):** Users praise the restaurant-level flavor, culinary diversity (dozens of international cuisines), and generous portion sizes. Critiques mention variability between different regional kitchens/chefs and packaging bulk.

---

## 2. Side-by-Side Comparison Matrix

| Service | Format | Primary Health / Dietary Angle | Starting / Range Price | Shipping / Delivery Fee | Minimum Order | Skip & Cancel Terms | Trustpilot Rating |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |

| **Sunbasket** | Hybrid (Kits + Prepared + Market) | Organic produce; ADA Diabetes-Friendly, Paleo, Med. | From $9.99 / serving | Free 1st delivery; ongoing fee not shown on how-it-works | 2 meals x 2 people (4 servings) | Skip or cancel online anytime before cutoff (12pm PST) | 4.3 / 5 (267 reviews) |
| **Trifecta** | Prepared Meals (Macro-Focused) | 100% Organic ingredients; athletic macro balance; clean | Plans from $104.93 – $110.99/wk (~$15/meal) | Not shown on main plans page | 7 meals / week (or $119 A La Carte) | Requires 7 days advance notice to skip or cancel | 3.5 / 5 (132 reviews) |

---

## 3. Final Recommendations for the 3 Target Cases

### Case 1: Best Overall Healthy Option — **Green Chef**
* **Why It Wins:** If your primary objective is uncompromising nutritional integrity, Green Chef remains the gold standard among national services. It is both **USDA Certified Organic** and certified by the **Clean Label Project**, meaning its ingredients undergo third-party testing for heavy metals and environmental toxins. Its recipes are formulated around nutrient-dense whole foods across distinct clinical styles (Mediterranean, Gut & Brain Health, Calorie Smart, High Protein), backed by high customer satisfaction ratings (4.0/5 across thousands of reviews). For home cooks who want clean, certified ingredients without having to audit labels themselves, it delivers the highest quality ceiling.

### Case 2: Best Budget-Conscious Option — **Hungryroot**
*(Notable Prepared Alternative: Factor)*
* **Why It Wins:** Healthy meal services often carry steep premiums ($13 to $16+ per serving). Hungryroot breaks this barrier by pairing meal-kit prep with an online grocery model. It delivers dinners starting at **$8.99/serving**, lunches at **$5.99**, breakfasts at **$3.99**, and snacks from **$1.99**, while offering **free shipping on all orders over $70**. Crucially, it does not sacrifice health for price: its sourcing standards blacklist over 200 artificial sweeteners, hydrogenated oils, artificial colorings, and preservatives. You get high-quality everyday eating at a fraction of traditional meal kit prices.
* *(Note: If you strictly want zero-cook prepared meals on a budget, **Factor** offers the most economical entry point among fresh prepared services, scaling down to **$10.99/meal**).*

### Case 3: Best Option for Maximum Flexibility & Customization — **Sunbasket**
* **Why It Wins:** Sunbasket solves the rigid constraint that plagues most meal services by operating as a true **two-track hybrid**. In a single weekly box, you can order traditional 15-to-30-minute cook-it-yourself meal kits for evenings when you have time, alongside zero-prep "Fresh & Ready" single-serve microwave/oven trays for busy nights, plus market grocery add-ons (egg bites, clean proteins, bone broths). Furthermore, it caters to 8+ clinically backed dietary patterns (including American Diabetes Association approved recipes, Paleo, Keto, and Mediterranean), accommodates 2- or 4-person household sizes, has a low 4-serving minimum order, and allows flexible delivery forwarding or skipping with an industry-leading 4.3/5 customer review rating.

What is Hungryroot?

Hungryroot is a subscription service that provides AI-assisted meal and grocery delivery. You tell us what you like and don't like, and each week, we pick out healthy recipes, prepared meals, and groceries that we think you'll enjoy and deliver them to your door. The more you use Hungryroot, the better we get at shopping for you. With over 50,000 chef-crafted recipes, and new recipes and grocery items added every month, there’s always something fresh to try.

Hungryroot practices strict sourcing standards, screening out over 200+ ingredients like artificial sweeteners, dyes, additives, preservatives, and hydrogenated oils so you don’t have to.

How does it work?

Each week, we’ll offer new suggestions based on your tastes, from quick breakfasts to nourishing snacks to easy dinners. You can always edit your delivery to get exactly what you’d like. Then comes the best part: we deliver your groceries, prepared meals, and recipes straight to your door. All you have to do is cook (most recipes take less than 15 minutes!), eat, and enjoy. We offer weekly deliveries to make sure your fridge stays stocked with all of your healthy living essentials. It’s easy to skip a delivery, reschedule it, or cancel your subscription anytime in the app.

After you checkout, you’ll see our grocery, recipe, and prepared meal suggestions based on your responses to the quiz. You can take our recommendations or choose from ~1,000 groceries and over 50,000 chef-crafted recipes. You’ll find products from fan-favorite brands, like Siggi’s, Kevin’s, and Annie’s, and up-and-coming brands we think you’ll love. Our foods always meet our super-high standards: made from whole, trusted ingredients and free from partially hydrogenated oils, high-fructose corn syrup, and artificial colors, sweeteners, and preservatives.

Do you have food for kids?

Absolutely! Our sourcing and culinary teams are always looking for high-quality options in every aisle to make the whole family happy. That includes the staples (like milk and eggs), tons of easy, packable snacks (like fruit snacks and pretzels), and quick, crowd-pleasing recipes like pesto pasta.

Frequently Asked Questions
What is Hungryroot?

Hungryroot is a subscription service that provides AI-assisted meal and grocery delivery. You tell us what you like and don't like, and each week, we pick out healthy recipes, prepared meals, and groceries that we think you'll enjoy and deliver them to your door. If you don’t like any recommendations you can change them before we ship your weekly box. Everything we sell is high quality — no fake ingredients or additives, just real, good food. The more you use Hungryroot, the better we get at shopping for you. With over 50,000 chef-crafted recipes, and new recipes and grocery items added every month, there’s always something fresh to try.

Hungryroot practices strict sourcing standards, screening out over 200+ ingredients like artificial sweeteners, dyes, additives, preservatives, and hydrogenated oils so you don’t have to.

How does it work?

Each week, we’ll offer new suggestions based on your tastes, from quick breakfasts to nourishing snacks to easy dinners. You can always edit your delivery to get exactly what you’d like. Then comes the best part: we deliver your groceries, prepared meals, and recipes straight to your door. All you have to do is cook (most recipes take less than 15 minutes!), eat, and enjoy. See more here.

Can I skip or cancel?

We offer weekly deliveries to make sure your fridge stays stocked with all of your healthy living essentials. It’s easy to skip a delivery, reschedule it, or cancel your subscription anytime in the app.

What will I get in my delivery?

After you checkout, you’ll see our grocery, recipe, and prepared meal suggestions based on your responses to the quiz. You can take our recommendations or choose from ~1,000 groceries and over 50,000 chef-crafted recipes. You’ll find products from fan-favorite brands, like Siggi’s, Kevin’s, and Annie’s, and up-and-coming brands we think you’ll love. Our foods always meet our super-high standards: made from whole, trusted ingredients and free from partially hydrogenated oils, high-fructose corn syrup, and artificial colors, sweeteners, and preservatives.

Do you have food for kids?

Absolutely! Our sourcing and culinary teams are always looking for high-quality options in every aisle to make the whole family happy. That includes the staples (like milk and eggs), tons of easy, packable snacks (like fruit snacks and pretzels), and quick, crowd-pleasing recipes like pesto pasta.

Where do you deliver?

We deliver to most zip codes in the 48 contiguous states and Washington D.C. Unfortunately, we don’t deliver to Hawaii and Alaska, P.O. Boxes, or APO/FPO/DPO. We’re working on making it possible to deliver to all zip codes across the country in the future!

Can I choose what food I want?

Absolutely! You can edit everything in your delivery and get exactly what you want.

Can I change my plan later?

Of course. You can make changes to your plan—or update your dietary needs and preferences—at any time.

How does the subscription work?

Each week we’ll recommend groceries and recipes just for you, and you can make any changes you like. Then, we deliver everything right to your door. Skip any week, pause your deliveries, or cancel any time.

How much do plans cost?

You choose exactly how much food you want, and the more you add to your delivery, the more you save. (We bet your grocery store doesn’t offer that!) You can get dinners as low as $8.99 per serving, lunch for $5.99, and breakfast for $3.99. We also offer our Best Price Program, which gives you access to brands you love — like Annie’s, Koia, Harvest Snaps, and more — at the cheapest prices you’ll find anywhere. (Did you know that Hungryroot customers save up to 40% each week by ditching takeout and reducing food waste? Nice!)

How do you keep the shipped food cold / fresh?

When packing your weekly box, we use insulation and ice packs to keep refrigerated items cold during shipping. In the box, anything that’s shelf stable is separated from the refrigerated section of the box to help maximize refrigeration for the items that need it. All materials are 100% recyclable.

How do I apply my promo code?

At checkout, you’ll be able to apply your discount code.

What happens if there is a problem with my order?

If your order isn’t perfect, we have a self-help form where you can report what’s wrong and take various steps to remedy the situation. If a shipment is late or missing, please contact our Customer Care team to help resolve your issue.

How does Hungryroot save me $?

The average Hungryroot customer saves $200 on takeout and $22+ each week on groceries. How? We source directly from the best brands, and—with over 50,000 chef-crafted recipes—help you make the most of your food each week. That means less food waste, fewer trips to the grocery store, and a very happy fridge.

How are you different?

Hungryroot is an online grocery store, so you can buy pretty much anything you need or want to eat in a week, not just get a few meals delivered. With over 50,000 chef-crafted recipes and a constantly growing selection of grocery staples, snacks, beverages, and sweets, we offer far more variety than traditional meal kit services. If you want a bit more control over your weekly food order, you can search or shop by recipe or grocery item on our site. If you prefer to hand all of the planning, decision-making, and shopping to us, our predictive technology proactively picks out personalized recipes and grocery staples and automatically adds them to your cart through SmartCart™, so all you need to do is review and approve your weekly grocery order. Think of it like meal planning on autopilot, where you stay in control but never have to start from scratch.

Hungryroot also has strict sourcing standards, screening out over 200+ ingredients like artificial sweeteners, dyes, additives, preservatives, and hydrogenated oils so you don’t have to.

Who are the chefs behind the recipes at Hungryroot?

People who’ve spent their careers obsessed with food. Our recipes come from an in-house team of trained chefs — from French pastry programs to restaurant kitchens to test kitchens at national food magazines — who cook, taste, and fuss over every detail. We use smart tools to scale our library, but a chef tastes, refines, and signs off on each dish so it’s delicious and foolproof in a real home kitchen.

Common Questions
What is Factor?
Factor is a ready-to-heat meal service designed to empower your active lifestyle. We take care of the planning, prepping, and cooking, so you can focus on your goals—not on what’s for dinner. Our chefs and dietitians work hand in hand to create fresh, flavourful meals that are as nutritious as they are delicious. Delivered right to your door, each meal is ready to heat and enjoy in minutes.

\nFlexibility is at the heart of Factor.
\nYou’re in control: choose the weeks you want a delivery, pick your favourites from our rotating menu, skip a week, or pause your subscription anytime.
Why choose Factor?
Factor is the easiest way to eat well without the stress. We do the shopping, chopping, and cooking so you can focus on your goals.

• Delivered fresh, never frozen\*
• Chef-Prepared, Dietitian-Approved: You don't have to choose between flavour and nutrition. Our culinary team and dietitians work together to create meals that are scientifically designed to fuel your body and taste amazing.
• Flexible to your lifestyle: Whether you’re Keto, High Protein, Max 550 kcal or Pescetarian, we have a plan for you. Plus, you can pause, skip, or cancel your subscription at any time - you are always in control.

\*Our meals are delivered fresh to your door. Just heat, eat, and enjoy in minutes - no prep or cleanup required.
Can I cancel anytime?
Yes. You can cancel your subscription at any time through your account settings.
Just keep in mind that once an order has been processed after your weekly cut-off, it can no longer be changed or canceled for that week.

If you wish to cancel your first Factor box, please reach out to our customer care.
How long will my meals stay fresh?
Each meal is labeled with a best-before date so you’ll always know how long it stays fresh. Just keep your meals refrigerated and enjoy them before the date shown on the label.
Are Factor meals gluten-free?
Most of our meals are made without ingredients containing gluten, however, they are not certified gluten-free. All meals are prepared in facilities that also handle gluten-containing ingredients, and cross-contact is possible. As such, our meals are not recommended for individuals with celiac disease or severe gluten sensitivity.

CANCEL
Getting Started
What are the benefits of Factor?

Factor takes the stress out of healthy living. We provide fresh, ready-prepared meals that support even the busiest of lifestyles! We shop, prep, cook, and deliver to your door for you so you can experience the benefits of clean eating without the hassle. When you are fit, you look great, feel amazing and have the energy and focus you need. As an added bonus, our team of dietitians is always available for extra accountability to help you crush your goals with our nutrition coaching programs!

How soon can I get my first order?

We deliver Saturday, Sunday, Monday, Tuesday or Wednesday, depending on your zip code. Our cutoff for any new or modified orders is dependent on your delivery day. For Saturday and Sunday Deliveries, the cutoff is Tuesday at 11:59 pm CT, one week prior to delivery. For all other delivery days, the cutoff will be Wednesday at 11:59 CT for deliveries the following week.

After your first order, you’ll start receiving a box of food every week! You will always have until your cutoff time to modify the order, including the meal selections, plan size, and billing and shipping information.

We need a week of lead time because all meals are completely made fresh-to-order by our chefs. We wait until after the cutoff to order ingredients, so we can assure our ingredients are fresh and we don't have too much.

How do I view the menu without signing up?

You can view our current menu without providing any personal information! On a desktop or laptop, just click, "WEEKLY MENU" at the top of our homepage. On a mobile device, click on the dropdown menu at the top of the page (3 horizontal lines), and click on "WEEKLY MENU."

Are meals fresh or frozen?

Always fresh. We deliver the meals in insulated boxes filled with frozen gel packs designed to keep your food at refrigerated temperatures through transit. Once you receive your meals, you should place them in the fridge ASAP. Once in the fridge, your meals will stay fresh for at least 7 days. Our meals are intended to be enjoyed fresh for optimal quality, we do not recommend freezing.

How do I apply a promo or coupon code during checkout?

When you get started with signup, you can add a promo code or coupon in the section that asks 'Do you have a discount code?'. You can input the code or coupon at checkout.

How many people does one meal feed?

Each meal feeds one adult for one meal. Our meals will vary in nutrition facts and ingredients, so always make sure to check this before ordering each week. You can view a full nutrition label and list of ingredients for each meal by clicking on the image of the meal on our menu page.

Some of our breakfast options work well to be split in two for a lighter breakfast.

While you can cancel at any time, canceling your subscription does not cancel existing orders. If you cancel your subscription after the weekly cutoff time and an automated order was placed, that order cannot be canceled and you will receive it the following week. Frequently Asked Questions
What are your different meal options?
You can choose from recipes that fit a range of dietary and lifestyle preferences. We offer a variety of meals from Paleo, Vegetarian, Diabetes-Friendly, High Protein, Low Calorie and more. You can always mix & match to customize your delivery from our full menu.
What types of meals does Sunbasket offer?
We offer a full spectrum of meal solutions from our Pre-Made Meals to our Meal Kits that simplify cooking with pre-portioned ingredients and easy-to-follow recipes. We also have our premium Chef’s Table Meal Kits with elevated flavors and proteins, for a special occasion, or just Wednesday.
Is my subscription flexible?
Yes, you can skip your delivery for any week before the weekly cutoff, 12pm PST / 3pm EST. You have also the option to forward your box to a temporary address, change your delivery address, or cancel your subscription at any time.
What if I have food allergies or intolerances?
Sunbasket recipes are packed in a facility that handles gluten as well as all major food allergens: milk, eggs, fish, crustacean shellfish, tree nuts, peanuts, wheat, soybeans, and sesame. Our Gluten-Free Friendly recipes are prepared in the same facility as our other meals, and may not be suitable for those diagnosed with celiac disease. If you have a very serious food allergy or intolerance, we recommend that you do not order from Sunbasket.

*Sunbasket meals are prepared in a facility that handles wheat, and while the Gluten-Free Friendly meal plan follows a gluten-free diet, due to risk of cross-contamination, meals are not suitable for people with severe gluten intolerance. Plans & Pricing
3 months ago Updated

When you sign up, you’ll start by building your first order with your favorites. During checkout, those selections automatically place you on a default meal plan, helping us tailor future orders to your preferences.

Don’t worry, you’re not locked in. You can change your plan at any time in your account settings after signing up.

For reference, we currently offer three meal plans:

Meal Kit
Everything you need to make a flavor-packed meal with just the right amount of prep.

Offered in three 2-serving or two 4-serving options ($13.25-$14.25 per serving) 
Preferences: Chef’s Choice, Gluten-Free, Less Prep, High Protein

Ready to Eat (RTE)
No prep, no planning—meals ready in 2 minutes or less.

6 single-serve meals at $13-$18 each
Preferences: Chef’s Choice

Mix & Match
The ultimate flexibility. This plan combines Meal Kits, Ready to Eat meals, and Grocery items in one plan.

Preferences: Chef’s Choice, Gluten-Free, High Fiber, High Protein

Every order is fully customizable, so you can follow our dietitian-curated plans or adjust your meals however you like, any time.

Order & shipping details:

$65 minimum when making changes to an order
Orders $120+ ship free
A $15 shipping surcharge may apply for select zip codes and will be reflected in your cart if applicable

Want to explore meals and build your first order? Shop this week's menu to get started.

  {
    "category": "daily-harvest-101",
    "searchContent": "how does daily harvest work? daily harvest makes it easy to eat more fruits and vegetables by offering a variety of nourishing, chef-crafted options for any time of day. you can order via subscription or one-time purchase. if you create a subscription, you can modify your items, delivery schedule, and subscription whenever you'd like. manage your subscription from our website or download our mobile app to make your experience even smoother.you can find the ios app in the apple store here.you can find the android app in the google play store here.",

    "category": "digital-product",
    "searchContent": "will i receive an order reminder? if you have a subscription, order reminders will be sent via email two days before your order is processed. you do not need to opt in to our newsletter to receive these transactional reminders.additionally, if you haven’t already, you can download our app so you can easily manage your plan moving forward with push notifications enabled. you can find the ios app in the apple store by clicking here and the android app in the google play store by clicking here.",
    "text": "Will I receive an Order Reminder?"

    "text": "How do I redeem a gift card?"
  },
  {
    "category": "gifts",
    "searchContent": "can i give daily harvest as a gift? we offer two options for purchasing a gift card. physical gift cards and e-gift cards. to see both options, be sure to check out our gift guide page here.to purchase a digital e-gift card, visit this link. our gift cards are the perfect something for the perfect someone—delivered right to their inbox. digital gifts are available in denominations of $50, $75, $100, $125, $150 and $200. to purchase a physical gift card, visit this link. what's inside? a $50 or $100 gift card and a reusable, bpa–free daily harvest smoothie tumbler nestled into a gift box so gorgeous you don’t even have to wrap it. how it works:1. the gift box will arrive to the recipient within 2-4 business days.2. we'll also email the recipient with details on how to use the gift card (you can choose the date they receive the email so the surprise is not ruined).3. they can then redeem their gift card to order a box of daily harvest any time they like.we also offer pre-selected smoothie gift boxes if you'd like to send a box of smoothies straight to their door. to redeem a gift card on a subscription purchase, you must apply it in your cart/box before the checkout process. for one-time box purchases, simply enter the code for your gift card at the checkout.",

    "searchContent": "can i use my fsa/hsa dollars on a daily harvest order? yes, if qualified. for subscriptions: make your purchase and do not pay with an hsa/fsa card during checkout. after your purchase, check your confirmation screen or receipt email for a link to the truemed survey. take the health survey and a licensed provider will review your answers to determine eligibility. if eligible, you will receive a letter of medical necessity within 1-2 days. note: the survey must be taken on the same day as your purchase. follow the guide included in your letter of medical necessity to submit your purchase for reimbursement. for one-time purchases: simply select truemed as your payment option at checkout and use your fsa or hsa card as you would any other credit card. if you do not have sufficient hsa/fsa funds, you can split your payment between your credit card and hsa/fsa card. truemed is for qualified customers. hsa/fsa tax savings vary. learn more at truemed.com/disclosures",

How CookUnity works
Chef-made meals in your
kitchen, every day.

CookUnity is the first ever chef-to-you delivery service for busy people who want to eat well.

1. Pick your weekly plan

Tell us what you like (and what you don’t) and pick a meal plan.
Get as few as 4 or as many as 16 meals a week.

2. Receive delivery weekly

Now’s the fun part—choose from dozens of meals and pick the ones you’d like.
Menus are posted two weeks in advance and we’ll tailor them to match your diet.

3. Heat and plate

Meals arrive fresh (not frozen) in compostable, recyclable, or reusable packaging, with expiration dates, heating instructions, and nutrition information
For best results, heat your meals in the oven. We’ll text when your meals are on the way.

4. Repeat

A few days before your next delivery, we’ll text with our recommendations. Stick with our selections or choose your own—it’s up to you.
Need a break? You can reschedule, skip a week or pause your subscription anytime.

We stand by our Standards

Our packaging is compostable and recyclable. We use leading packaging technology to keep meals fresh in the fridge for 4-7 days.

At CookUnity, we strive to provide transparent pricing information to all our customers. Below, you will find a comprehensive guide to understanding the taxes and fees associated with your subscription, ensuring there are no surprises when it comes to billing.

How Taxes Are Calculated
Location: Where you live influences your taxes due to state and local tax regulations.
To ensure accuracy in tax calculation, we use Avalara, a leading tax software. Avalara automatically determines the applicable taxes by analyzing your delivery address and the meals you have selected. This sophisticated tool ensures that the correct amount is collected and remitted to the appropriate tax authorities on your behalf.

 Johans
3 months ago Updated

We’re sorry to see you go. If you need to cancel your CookUnity subscription, you can do it in just a few clicks by following the steps below.

Before you cancel, keep in mind that canceling your subscription stops future weeks, but it doesn’t automatically cancel orders that were already processed/billed. If you have an upcoming delivery that’s already been processed, you may still receive it.

 

Video Tutorial

 

Cancel From Settings (Website experience)
Log in to your CookUnity account and go to your Home Page.
In the bottom-left corner, click your Account icon (the circle with your initials).
Select Settings.
Scroll down until you find Cancel Subscription.
Click Cancel Subscription to open the cancellation flow.
Select a reason for your cancellation (for example: moving to a different state).

# Healthy Meal Delivery Services Comparison & Final Recommendations

To help you establish a sustainable, genuinely healthy meal delivery routine, Hungryroot was evaluated against seven other nationally available, health-focused meal delivery services (8 total contenders):
1. **Hungryroot**
2. **Green Chef**
3. **Factor (Factor75)**
4. **Sunbasket**
5. **Trifecta Nutrition**
6. **Purple Carrot**
7. **Daily Harvest**
8. **CookUnity**

Every entry below draws its operational facts directly from each brand’s live official public plan, pricing, and FAQ pages, sanity-checked against reputable public customer review data (Trustpilot).

---

## 1. Official Service Profiles (from Public Plan & Pricing Pages)

### 1. Hungryroot
* **Format:** Hybrid (grocery store variety + quick-prep recipe meal kits + ready-to-eat prepared meals and snacks; over 50,000 recipes and ~1,000 grocery items).
* **Dietary Styles & Nutrition Angle:** Sourcing standards screen out over 200 artificial additives, artificial sweeteners, dyes, preservatives, and partially hydrogenated oils. Caters to Vegan, Vegetarian, Pescatarian, Keto, Gluten-Free, and Dairy-Free lifestyles. Focus on whole ingredients, wild-caught seafood, and grass-fed meats.
* **Price Range:** Dinners from $8.99/serving, Lunches from $5.99/serving, Breakfasts from $3.99/serving, Snacks/Sweets from $1.99, Drinks from $3.99, Supplements from $0.49.
* **Shipping / Delivery Fees:** Free shipping on orders over $70; standard shipping fee for orders under $70 is not shown on the public FAQ page.
* **Minimum Order Structure:** Order minimum corresponds to plan size (minimum plan deliveries generally require hitting the $65–$70 threshold).
* **Ordering, Skipping & Canceling:** Weekly subscription model. An AI-driven SmartCart suggests meals/groceries based on preferences. Subscribers can fully edit the cart, reschedule, skip any week, or pause/cancel anytime via account settings in the web portal or mobile app prior to the weekly billing cutoff.
* **Customer Sentiment (Trustpilot: 4.2 / 5 across 7,325 reviews):** Customers praise the broad grocery variety, healthy pantry staples, and time saved on meal prep. Critiques typically mention occasional delivery carrier delays or damaged produce during summer transit.

---

### 2. Green Chef
* **Format:** Meal kits (pre-measured ingredients, pre-made signature sauces/marinades, recipe cards; ready in ~30 minutes).
* **Dietary Styles & Nutrition Angle:** Certified organic produce and proteins; certified by the Clean Label Project (tested for heavy metals/toxins). Specific plans include Mediterranean, Plant Based (Vegan/Vegetarian), Gluten Free, High Protein, Calorie Smart (≤650 kcal), Carb Smart, and Functional Nutrition (gut-friendly).
* **Price Range:** $13.99 per serving (standard baseline across 2-, 4-, and 6-person box sizes on the public plan selector).
* **Shipping / Delivery Fees:** Not shown on the public plan configuration page prior to registration/checkout (standard shipping is typically $10.99 at checkout).
* **Minimum Order Structure:** 3 meals for 2 people (6 servings) or 2 meals for 4 people (8 servings) per week.
* **Ordering, Skipping & Canceling:** Weekly subscription. Weekly menu changes allow custom recipe selection after checkout. Customers can skip weeks in advance or cancel anytime online through account settings before the weekly cutoff deadline.
* **Customer Sentiment (Trustpilot: 4.0 / 5 across 4,919 reviews):** Highly rated for ingredient freshness, restaurant-quality organic sauces, and diet-adherent recipes. Criticisms center on the premium price per serving and occasional transit packaging mishaps.

---

### 3. Factor (Factor75)
* **Format:** Prepared meals (fresh, never frozen, ready-to-heat in ~2 minutes).
* **Dietary Styles & Nutrition Angle:** Dietitian-designed and chef-prepared. Focus areas include Keto, High Protein (up to 53g protein per meal), Calorie Smart (≤550 kcal), Flexitarian, Vegetarian, and Pescatarian.
* **Price Range:**
  * 6 meals/week: $13.49 per serving
  * 8 meals/week: $12.99 per serving
  * 10 meals/week: $12.49 per serving
  * 12 meals/week: $11.99 per serving
  * 14 meals/week: $11.49 per serving
  * 18 meals/week: $10.99 per serving
* **Shipping / Delivery Fees:** Not shown on the public FAQ cost section (standard delivery fee is typically $10.99 added during final order billing).
* **Minimum Order Structure:** Minimum plan size is 6 single-serving meals per week.
* **Ordering, Skipping & Canceling:** Continuous auto-renewing subscription. Customers select meals weekly. Changes, pauses, skips, or cancellations must be completed before the weekly cutoff (11:59 PM CT on Tuesday for weekend delivery; Wednesday for weekday delivery).
* **Customer Sentiment (Trustpilot: 3.5 / 5 across 12,496 reviews):** Customers appreciate the zero-prep convenience, high protein density, and robust flavor. Common complaints relate to delivery carrier delays and customer support responsiveness during resolution of missing boxes.

---

### 4. Sunbasket
* **Format:** Hybrid (Meal Kits + Pre-Made "Fresh & Ready" meals + curated Market grocery/breakfast items).
* **Dietary Styles & Nutrition Angle:** Certified organic produce, responsibly sourced meats and wild-caught seafood, clean-ingredient housemade sauces. Dedicated diet plans include Paleo, Carb-Conscious (25–35g net carbs), Gluten-Free Friendly, Diabetes-Friendly (approved by the American Diabetes Association), Vegetarian, Pescatarian, Mediterranean, and Keto-Friendly.
* **Price Range:** Meals start at $9.99 per serving.
* **Shipping / Delivery Fees:** Free shipping on first delivery; ongoing standard shipping fee is not explicitly stated on the public How-It-Works page (typically $9.99 at checkout).
* **Minimum Order Structure:** Minimum of 2 dinners per week (available in 2 or 4 servings each, making 4 total servings the minimum order).
* **Ordering, Skipping & Canceling:** Weekly subscription. Customers can freely mix meal kits and ready-to-eat meals in the same order. Skips, address forwarding, or cancellations are managed online anytime before the weekly cutoff (12:00 PM PST / 3:00 PM EST on your order cutoff day).
* **Customer Sentiment (Trustpilot: 4.3 / 5 across 267 reviews):** Consistently praised for top-tier ingredient quality, high produce freshness, and the flexibility to blend quick kits with zero-prep meals. Downsides mentioned include higher costs on premium seafood/steak upgrades.

---

### 5. Trifecta Nutrition
* **Format:** Prepared meals and bulk meal prep (vacuum-sealed, fully cooked, heat & eat in 2–3 minutes).
* **Dietary Styles & Nutrition Angle:** 100% organic ingredients, macro-balanced for fitness enthusiasts and athletes. Gluten-free facility, humanely raised clean proteins, zero refined sugars or artificial additives. Plans include Clean, Keto, Paleo, Whole30 Friendly, High Protein Vegetarian, and High Protein Vegan.
* **Price Range:**
  * High Protein Vegan / Vegetarian: from $104.93 / week
  * Clean, Keto, Paleo, Whole30 Friendly: from $110.99 / week
  * Meal Prep & Signature A La Carte: from $119.00 / week (individual meals roughly $15–$16 each when purchased in 7-meal baseline packages).
* **Shipping / Delivery Fees:** Not shown on the main plan page (free shipping promos apply to certain packages; standard shipping is revealed in cart).
* **Minimum Order Structure:** 7 meals per week (or $119 minimum for A La Carte meal prep).

## 3. Final Recommendations for the 3 Target Cases

### Case 1: Best Overall Healthy Option — **Green Chef**
* **Why It Wins:** If your primary objective is uncompromising nutritional integrity, Green Chef remains the gold standard among national services. It is both **USDA Certified Organic** and certified by the **Clean Label Project**, meaning its ingredients undergo third-party testing for heavy metals and environmental toxins. Its recipes are formulated around nutrient-dense whole foods across distinct clinical styles (Mediterranean, Gut & Brain Health, Calorie Smart, High Protein), backed by high customer satisfaction ratings (4.0/5 across thousands of reviews). For home cooks who want clean, certified ingredients without having to audit labels themselves, it delivers the highest quality ceiling.

### Case 2: Best Budget-Conscious Option — **Hungryroot**
*(Notable Prepared Alternative: Factor)*
* **Why It Wins:** Healthy meal services often carry steep premiums ($13 to $16+ per serving). Hungryroot breaks this barrier by pairing meal-kit prep with an online grocery model. It delivers dinners starting at **$8.99/serving**, lunches at **$5.99**, breakfasts at **$3.99**, and snacks from **$1.99**, while offering **free shipping on all orders over $70**. Crucially, it does not sacrifice health for price: its sourcing standards blacklist over 200 artificial sweeteners, hydrogenated oils, artificial colorings, and preservatives. You get high-quality everyday eating at a fraction of traditional meal kit prices.
* *(Note: If you strictly want zero-cook prepared meals on a budget, **Factor** offers the most economical entry point among fresh prepared services, scaling down to **$10.99/meal**).*

### Case 3: Best Option for Maximum Flexibility & Customization — **Sunbasket**
* **Why It Wins:** Sunbasket solves the rigid constraint that plagues most meal services by operating as a true **two-track hybrid**. In a single weekly box, you can order traditional 15-to-30-minute cook-it-yourself meal kits for evenings when you have time, alongside zero-prep "Fresh & Ready" single-serve microwave/oven trays for busy nights, plus market grocery add-ons (egg bites, clean proteins, bone broths). Furthermore, it caters to 8+ clinically backed dietary patterns (including American Diabetes Association approved recipes, Paleo, Keto, and Mediterranean), accommodates 2- or 4-person household sizes, has a low 4-serving minimum order, and allows flexible delivery forwarding or skipping with an industry-leading 4.3/5 customer review rating.
